# Official theme log

Daily theme runs append one line per new official palette so later runs
do not reuse ids or topics. These ids are retired from desktop core;
named palettes ship as `dripnex/theme-<slug>` satellite packs.

Format: `YYYY-MM-DD | id | name | topic | colorScheme`

2026-08-22 | dripnex-matcha | Matcha | green-tea paper, calm reading | light
2026-08-22 | dripnex-phosphor | Phosphor | amber CRT / terminal glow | dark
2026-08-22 | dripnex-fog | Fog | coastal gray morning, muted blue accent | light
2026-08-24 | dripnex-harbor-dusk | Harbor Dusk | coastal evening, mist text, muted teal, amber lanterns | dark
